summary_markdown: The discussion focused on refining the data selection for a demographic analysis. The updated criteria involve using one day of targeting data combined with one month of area data, specifically focusing on areas with the maximum number of days of stay. Additionally, facilities used for accommodation must be excluded from the calculation.
decisions: Updated sample criteria established: 1 day target + 1 month area; focus on max stay areas; exclude residential facilities.
